$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. DeviceSnapshot per FB-RAT-DEV-002 (device object model) and FB-RAT-DEV-005 (verification before good state). Typically carried as the `payload` of a ContractEnvelope<DeviceSnapshot> (see schemas/common/envelope.schema.json). `snapshotId` is this object's own FB-RAT-COM-002 stable ID.
title: DeviceSnapshot
description: A point-in-time belief about what firmware a device is running and whether that belief is verified. FB-RAT-DEV-005: update last-known-good only after protocol/read-back/version/self-test verification — `lastKnownGood` is structurally forced false unless `verification.state` is VERIFIED. See docs/ratified/DEVICE_STATE_AND_SAFETY_SPEC.md §5.

snapshotId.description: Globally unique stable ID for this snapshot (FB-RAT-COM-002). Snapshots are append-only (FB-RAT-COM-006, general convention) — a corrected belief about device state is a NEW snapshot, never an in-place edit of an old one.

deviceIdentityId.description: References the DeviceIdentity.deviceIdentityId this snapshot describes (schemas/devices/device-identity.schema.json).

connectionStateAtCapture.description: The DeviceConnection.state (schemas/devices/connection.schema.json) at the instant this snapshot was captured. Duplicated locally per this repo's shared-sub-shape convention (docs/ratified/COMMON_CONVENTIONS.md §5).

firmwareArtifactId.description: References the FirmwareArtifact.firmwareArtifactId this snapshot believes is currently flashed on the device, when known. Null when no firmware identity is known (e.g. a freshly-discovered device before any flash/read-back has happened in this constellation's history).

firmwareDigest.description: The digest actually read back from the device (when the verification method supports a read-back digest), independent of `firmwareArtifactId` — this is what was directly OBSERVED on-device, which MAY differ from the artifact's own recorded digest if verification failed or used a different method (e.g. a version-string handshake that doesn't produce a full-image digest).

lastKnownGood.description: FB-RAT-DEV-005: true only once `verification.state` is VERIFIED (see the if/then below) — a snapshot MUST NOT claim last-known-good status on the strength of an operation merely 'completing' without independent verification.

capturedAtUtc.description: UTC instant this snapshot was captured (FB-RAT-COM-004).

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).

allOf.$comment: FB-RAT-DEV-005: lastKnownGood=true requires verification.state=VERIFIED — a snapshot cannot claim good-state status from an unverified or failed check.

state.description: Mirrors schemas/execution/receipt.schema.json's verification.state vocabulary for the same FB-RAT-EXE-009-shaped reason applied to devices: success/completion and verification are kept structurally separate.

method.description: Flash contract step 6's four verification methods (docs/ratified/DEVICE_STATE_AND_SAFETY_SPEC.md §4). Null when state is NOT_PERFORMED.

algorithm.description: Digest algorithm; SHA-256 or stronger only (FB-RAT-COM-005).

IntegrityRef.description: Duplicated from schemas/common/*.schema.json's $defs/IntegrityRef per this repo's convention (docs/ratified/COMMON_CONVENTIONS.md §5).
